notes.title: Enjoy now Wizards Tourney in online multiplayer version!
notes.notes:
The new update includes online multiplayer mode:

- Public games: Show your magical skills to people from all over the world in public game rooms.
- Private games: Challenge your friends in private game rooms in which you compete to be the greatest magician.

The online version is in Beta Phase, any comments to improve are welcome :)

notes.title: Changelog 1.1.3
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33550249/63baffedee08a38b9a12bab3765ff7829a78c74e.png[/img]

In this update, we have taken into account the feedback received during the [i]Lunar New Year[/i] event to make some changes:

- In [i]Tourney Mode[/i], in case of a tie, the wizard who has obtained less [i]Shame Points[/i] wins ([i]Shame Points[/i] are obtained by the players who are in last position to level the playing field).

- We have improved AI behavior to make it more human-like. This change is especially noticeable in [i]Mad Lab[/i].

- We have made some optimizations to improve performance.

That's all. Remember you can play Wizards Tourney online using [url=https://parsecgaming.com/]Parsec[/url]!

notes.title: Changelog 1.1.2
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33550249/5a065976dfd16d724e5278e296e88dcd76007c17.png[/img]

In this update, we have fixed some bugs and made a little gameplay adjustment taking into account your feedback during the Winter Sale.

[b]- Modified Tourney's [i]Shame Points system[/i]: now it will be granted to all wizards who are far behind the first one, not only the one with the lowest score.[/b]
- Adjusted [i]Mad Lab's physics system[/i]: now the Energy Sphere moves a bit slower and you will have more control over your own movement.
- Fixed a bug in [i]Shared Controller mode[/i] that occurred when the controller was disconnected.
- Fixed a bug that prevented using the controller's D-Pad in the Main Menu.
- Some adjustments in [i]Chinese texts [/i]format.

[i]Happy New Year and may the magic be with you![/i]

notes.title: Play Wizards Tourney online using Parsec
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33550249/dc4fc46246966bb50e83dce2260470c2013a78fa.png[/img]

Parsec is a platform that allows you to play online in games that only have local multiplayer (like Wizards Tourney). In Parsec you can find other wizards to play with.

Using Parsec is very easy and completely free. One of the players will be the host and will stream the game to the other players, who will then be able to control their characters using their own game controllers from their homes.

[h1]How to play[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Download the client from [url=https://parsecgaming.com/]parsecgaming.com[/url]
[*]Run it and create an account. Get your friends to do the same.
[*]To host a game, run Wizards Tourney. Then, go to Parsec and click "Create a Party" in the left menu and add Wizards Tourney to the approved apps list. [*]You can share the party link [noparse](parsec.gg/p/…)[/noparse] with your friends.
[*]To join a game, go to “Party finder” tab and Request to Join a Wizards Tourney party or use your friend’s party link.
[/olist]

[h1]See you in Parsec![/h1]

notes.title: Changelog 1.0.3
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33550249/9ba776f4dce0a46597236410bf592dbc2684e669.png[/img]

Hi!

First, check out this funny gameplay of Wizards Tourney:

https://youtu.be/SiOxWMaWzGk
And now, the changes and fixes of this version:

- We have improved graphics performance. Specifically, we have optimized the lighting calculations of each game scenario.
- We have also optimized our custom shaders and post-processing effects.
- As a result, Wizards Tourney will run smoother both in high-end PCs and older ones.
- We have improved sound effects.
- Some other small fixes.
(We have not made any significant gameplay changes in this update.)

And remember, you can play Wizards Tourney online using [url=https://parsecgaming.com/]Parsec[/url]!

notes.title: Shared Controller
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33550249/dccbc9737425b0f50a20dc28b318c57a3bb438ac.png[/img]

The experience of playing [b]Wizards Tourney[/b] is much better with a controller. However, not all of us have more than one at home. For this reason, we have implemented the [b]Shared Controller[/b] mode, which allows 2 players to use a single controller at the same time (or two controllers for 4 players). In addition, the battle to dominate the controller adds a new layer to the tournament!

[i]Remember, it's not cheating if a wizard did it![/i]
